scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,telegram,worker -c auto "npm -w @hooma/api run dev" "npm -w @hooma/web run dev" "npm -w @hooma/telegram run dev" "npm -w @hooma/worker run dev"
scripts.build:packages: npm -w @hooma/auth run build && npm -w @hooma/config run build && npm -w @hooma/contracts run build && npm -w @hooma/database run build && npm -w @hooma/domain run build && npm -w @hooma/storage run build && npm -w @hooma/testing run build && npm -w @hooma/ui run build
scripts.build:apps: npm -w @hooma/api run build && npm -w @hooma/worker run build && npm -w @hooma/web run build && npm -w @hooma/telegram run build
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.check: npm run architecture:check && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run deploy:preflight
